purpose: Repository supplement for practical pressure/intrinsic configuration choice; no physical fracture calibration.
assumptions: Three repeated warmed timings per single allocation are ranges, not confidence intervals.
Source-prior is another load model, not truth.
Capacity and sampled-memory diagnostics are not headline rates.

performance.claim: Compare measured aggregate rollout throughput, overhead and sampled process memory across small to large batches.
performance.marks: connected medians, raw repeats and min/max ranges; log batch axis
performance.uncertainty: n=3 repeats within one process/allocation; no independent GPU replicate CI

model-error-cost.claim: Extra intrinsic cost does not remove shared egg footprint/reference bias, while local admissibility and close-sheet support differ.
panels: B32 live overhead vs nominal four-state M/L tensor changes
convex/gap paired control tensor changes, unsupported N/A
local material cone force-norm violations on matched-supported cases
model-error-cost.marks: paired scatter, log-scaled labeled heatmap, individual audit scatter
model-error-cost.limitations: Cost and error use distinct representative native rollout vs frozen reference workloads. M/L is reconstructed-load difference, not experimental error.

reward-phase.claim: The named phase changes practical grasp ranking; model/radius changes observed amplitudes and counterfactual threshold decisions.
panels: whole-episode high minus low force peak
lift-phase high minus low force peak
reward-phase.marks: raw paired differences, n=3; color=model, shape=radius, fill=model
reward-phase.limitations: Ranks are stable across tested models/radii within a phase. No actual early termination or fracture threshold is fitted.

rendered_qa: Check final-size labels, overlap, grayscale/semantic shapes, SVG text, PDF embedded fonts, source hashes; manually view every final preview.
evidence_hierarchy: native raw benchmark repeats / independent reference fields / full raw reward traces
